questions.q: What are the two terms of the VAE objective?
options: Reconstruction and a KL penalty towards the prior
questions.answer: Reconstruction and a KL penalty towards the prior
questions.why: The evidence lower bound: E_q[log p(x|z)] − KL(q(z|x) ‖ N(0, I)).

questions.q: Why write z = μ + σ · ε?
options: The noise moves outside the gradient path, so sampling is differentiable
It removes the need for a decoder
questions.answer: The noise moves outside the gradient path, so sampling is differentiable
questions.why: This is the reparameterisation trick from Kingma and Welling.

questions.q: What is the scale factor for?
options: Bringing latents to about unit variance, as the samplers assume
questions.answer: Bringing latents to about unit variance, as the samplers assume
questions.why: The lab computes 1/std, and comfy/latent_formats.py holds the published constants.

questions.q: In the lab, what did the strong KL weight buy, and at what cost?
options: A latent midpoint that is one real bar, at about 26 times the reconstruction error of β = 0.001
questions.answer: A latent midpoint that is one real bar, at about 26 times the reconstruction error of β = 0.001
questions.why: Distance 0.047 against 9.762, while MSE is 0.0497 against 0.0019.

questions.q: Is a straight line between two SD latents promised to be meaningful?
options: No, its KL penalty is slight, and this toy cannot settle it
questions.answer: No, its KL penalty is slight, and this toy cannot settle it
questions.why: Rombach et al. use only a slight KL penalty, as the What is contested section explains.
